title: Is Europe now in the shadow of a Trump, Putin and Xi alliance? – podcast
summary_full: Andy Burnham is meeting western leaders in Berlin and Brussels this week, to discuss Ukraine and closer ties to the EU. Meanwhile, Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping have met at the Apec summit in China. Is this the start of a global shift of power away from Europe, or was it just a hyped-up photo opportunity?You can read Pippa Crerar’s article on the EU’s approach to a reset with the UK here Continue reading...
